_comment: The PharmAgentics platform questionnaire (core-008). Edit the wording, add or remove questions, and bump `version`; no code changes are needed. Item types: agree5 (1-5 agreement), nps (0-10), choice (one of), multi (any of), text (free text, `max` characters). `reverse: true` marks a negatively worded SUS statement (display only; the scoring in feedback.py knows the SUS order). Responses record the version they answered.
title: PharmAgentics platform questionnaire
intro: About five minutes. Answer for PharmAgentics as a whole, not one briefing. Skip anything that does not apply. Please do not write names or other personal details in the text answers.

items.text: I think that I would like to use PharmAgentics frequently.
